newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PROFIT-TAKING DRAGS ESTONIAN SHARES LOWER.
newsitem.headline: PROFIT-TAKING DRAGS ESTONIAN SHARES LOWER.

text.p: Most key Estonian shares fell further on Tuesday as a bout of profit-taking hit the market, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 129.2 million kroons as the Talse index fell 2.98 percent to close at 399.71.
"Profit taking from the recent big gains is affecting trade in many stocks," one dealer said.
But analysts dismissed the possibility of a major correction, saying that the market's recent record-breaking surge was based on sound fundamentals.
Hansapank was the most active stock, attracting 29 million kroons of trade to fall by 5.3 kroons to close at 219 kroons.
"We are seeing profit taking in banking stocks," another trader said.
Hoiupank fell 10 kroons to close at 255 kroons in turnover of 28.9 million kroons.
Forekspank was the main loser of the day, falling 18 kroons as news regarding its correspondent accounts in St Petersburg affected the stock.

The bank said that it would be seeking repayment of funds from the Russian budget that were transferred by the banks after the St Petersburg tax police ordered the accounts to be frozen for non-payment of taxes.
Forekspank will take the tax police to court on September 16 in a bid to recover the funds and seek damages.
"The St Petersburg tax police news has weakened the stock again, but there seems to be some buying interest there, so it may hold," a dealer said.
On the free market, total trade was 5.1 million kroons. Rakvere meat plant was again the most active stock with 2.6 million kroons changing hands to lose 0.25 kroons to close at 12.95 kroons.
